The developmental epigenomic analyses start from peak-count tables produced upstream of WGCNA. ENCODE ATAC/ChIP sample configuration JSON files are retained as processing records. This notebook inventories those records; it does not run alignment, peak calling or an unrecorded replacement pipeline. The peak-count inputs, fitted WGCNA networks and final annotated catalogs are distinct stages of the analysis.

## Inputs and saved objects

Paths are relative to the `CortexCode/` directory. **saved-results** inputs support routine rendering; **optional-rerun** inputs are read only when the corresponding analysis is enabled. Wildcards identify file collections.

| Mode | Input path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| saved-results | `data/upstream/ENCODE_configs/*.json` | Original assay processing records |

See [input locations](../INPUTS.md), [saved R objects](../SAVED_OBJECTS.md) and the [complete file inventory](../config/file_inventory.csv) for original source names, sizes and availability. These large inputs are not part of the Git checkout.

```{r setup, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
if (!exists("params", inherits = FALSE)) {
  params <- list(recompute = FALSE)
}
candidate_roots <- c(".", "..")
repo_dir <- candidate_roots[vapply(
  candidate_roots, function(path) file.exists(file.path(path, "R", "common.R")),
  logical(1)
)][1]
stopifnot(!is.na(repo_dir))
repo_dir <- normalizePath(repo_dir, winslash = "/")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  eval = isTRUE(params$recompute),

  message = FALSE,
  warning = TRUE,
  error = FALSE
)
```

## Processing configurations

Read the original JSON keys without embedding machine-specific execution paths in the notebook. Pipeline versions should be taken from the original execution records, not inferred from the current installation.

```{r processing-configurations, eval=TRUE}
configuration_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "data", "upstream", "ENCODE_configs")
configuration_files <- list.files(configuration_dir,
  pattern = "[.]json$",
  full.names = TRUE)
configuration_summary <- do.call(
  rbind, lapply(
    configuration_files, function(path) {
      settings <- jsonlite::fromJSON(path)
      title_key <- grep(
        "[.]title$", names(settings),
        value = TRUE
      )
      type_key <- grep(
        "[.]pipeline_type$", names(settings),
        value = TRUE
      )

      data.frame(
        Configuration = basename(path),
        Title = if (length(title_key))
          settings[[title_key[1]]] else NA_character_, Pipeline_type = if (length(type_key))
          settings[[type_key[1]]] else NA_character_
      )
    }
  )
)
configuration_summary
```
